notablePrerequisites: Overgrown Battlement does not have summoning sickness. You control at least five creatures with defender.
description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Overgrown Battlement.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
